single: One card, drawn for you alone. A single card can hold a whole evening, if you let it.
You asked for one answer, so the deck gives one image. Look at it a while before you read on.
three: Three cards lie before us — what was, what is, and what may yet come. Let us walk them in order.
Past, present, future: the same river seen from three bridges. We begin upstream.
celtic: Ten cards, laid in the old cross. It is a long story, and I will tell it slowly.
The Celtic Cross does not hurry, and neither shall we. Let us begin at the centre.
default: The cards are turned. Let us listen to what they say.

majorMajor: Two Major Arcana side by side — the forces at work here are larger than you, and they have noticed you.
Another trump follows. When the great cards travel in pairs, the lesson is not small.
crossArcana: The scale shifts now, from the great to the everyday — or back again. Both are true at once.
Notice how the deck moves between the vast and the ordinary; your life is lived in both.
bothReversed: Two reversals in a row. The cards are speaking in the quiet voice, the one that asks rather than tells.
Again the card is turned. Something in this story is happening underneath, not on the surface.

wands: Wands again — fire upon fire. Passion and will are the element of this reading; be careful what you burn.
cups: Cups follow Cups. Water on water: feeling runs through this like a river through a valley.
swords: Another Sword. The air grows sharp; this is a matter of mind, words, and the truths we tell.
pentacles: Pentacles twice. Earth on earth — the body, the work, the money, the slow and solid things.

closing: That is what the cards say tonight. What they mean is yours to decide; I only hold the lamp.
I do not tell futures, child — I tell stories, and you will know which parts are yours.
Take what is useful and leave the rest on the table. The cards will not be offended.
Sleep on it. The reading that matters is the one you remember in the morning.
Go gently. Whatever the cards showed, you were already carrying it in with you.
